Earlier @ggolemg asked for a rundown on making a simple liquid for fairly cheap.

For the sake of this example I'm using the Perfumer's Apprentice Menthol at 3%, PG based nicotine at 1.2%, and a VG/PG ratio of 50/50. This would be more than enough menthol for me, some might prefer stronger, some might prefer less. You'll definitely know the menthol is there at 3% If you're looking to vape on the cheap and minimize unknown risks from flavorings this is not a bad way to go. I also use .3% nic, so I'd get get far more end result liquid out of the liter of nicotine used in this example.

To make 2 Gallons of this liquid at once we need:

  • 908.4ml of 100mg/ml Nicotine base
  • 2649.5ml of PG
  • 3785ml of VG
  • 227.1ml of Menthol Flavoring

We'll source our ingredients in moderate bulk from the following retailers:

  • Perfumers Apprentice 2oz of Menthol Flavoring $30 + 5.25 Priority Shipping You can actually make this cheaper by sourcing menthol crystals and just adding directly to your base, but I don't feel like finding sources and doing math for this right now.

  • Vegetable Glycerine / Propylene Glycol 2 Gallons - $59.50

  • Right now my favorite supplier for nicotine is VapersTek, at 12mg/ml I wouldn't use anything else, I haven't noticed a significant difference between their "Throat Hit" and "EU Sourced" brandings. 1liter 100mg/ml - $45 + 5.56 First Class Shipping

For a total of $145.31, you'll have leftover PG/Nic Base/Menthol Flavoring. My calculator tells me that the actual cost to make 2 Gallons is $88.81 which would make this $0.0117 per ML.

I'd recommend mixing this up, shaking very well, and storing in refrigeration or a freezer. Lower concentrations of nicotine keep for quite a while at freezing temperatures.
Make 2 Gallons of Menthol Liquid For around $.01 Per ML
I personally hate menthol, and if my goal was to vape for as cheaply as possible I'd just use a VG/Nic base which would bring the cost per ML down to under $0.01.
So you would do zero flavor and zero pg?

If the goal was to vape as cheaply as possible.

I pretty much exclusively drip. If I was inclined to use a tank I'd cut the base with a bit of distilled water, because I don't like the taste of PG.

As it stands my costs are minimal because I develop recipes for more than just my own use. I do a lot of R&D with flavorings. I intend to stop vaping in the next 6-12 months, If I decide to continue nicotine use I'll probably switch to some kind of snus like solution using strips of Koh Gen Do cotton and a low strength VG nicotine base.

@ggolemg This is probably more than you were thinking, and I don't know if you have plans to quit vaping altogether. But you could scale this down to maybe a liter or two for around $.03-$.05 per ML using the same sources.
